title: The Cal Arts Story
content: The CalArts StoryfromChristine Ziemba (CalArts)onVimeo.The cultural life of Los Angeles seemed like such a glorious dream when Disney produced this video promoting the planned Hollywood campus for the CalArts art school. The voice is Sebastian Cabot, aka "Bagheera" in Jungle Book.------Previously on GJ: A visit to CalArts Animation.
